blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Major political parties in the House of Representatives backed on Monday the full disclosure of congressional district allocations under the proposed 2027 budget. Representatives of majority bloc parties – National Unity Party (NUP), Nationalist People’s Coalition (NPC), Lakas-Christian Muslim Democrat (Lakas-CMD), Partido Federal ng Pilipinas (PFP) and Nacionalista Party (NP) – expressed support for greater transparency to demonstrate that lawmakers are not hiding unscrutinized allocations. “We have no issue showing the projects in our respective districts,” Camarines Sur Rep. Arnie Fuentebella, who represented NPC, said in a media briefing in Filipino. “We want to be very transparent.” Lawmakers […]...
